notes.Precious Achiuwa: Keegan Murray is out again with ankle capsulitis, and Achiuwa played 39 minutes Sunday as the starter.
notes.Daniss Jenkins: Ausar Thompson is questionable, and Jenkins played 38 minutes when he started for him Sunday.
notes.Ron Holland: Ausar Thompson and Isaiah Joe are both questionable, which would open more wing minutes.
notes.Duncan Robinson: Isaiah Joe is questionable with a hip contusion, which would protect Robinson's minutes.
notes.Mitchell Robinson: He is not on Boston's injury report, so he is set to play the second night of the back-to-back.
notes.Neemias Queta: Mitchell Robinson is not on the injury report, so Queta stays in his backup role.
notes.Payton Pritchard: He scored 28 points in 22 minutes Monday in a blowout win, but much of that came from hot three-point shooting.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He played only 28 minutes Monday in a blowout and plays the second night of the back-to-back against Brooklyn.
notes.Domantas Sabonis: He has 18, 19 and 15 rebounds in his three games while Keegan Murray and Sacramento's backup centers Maxime Raynaud and Dylan Cardwell are out. Murray will be re-evaluated in 10 to 14 days.
notes.Luka Doncic: He scored 52 points with eight rebounds and 10 assists in 38 minutes Sunday, and his minutes have climbed in each game. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (meniscus), and this game has the highest total on the slate.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: He has 13, 13 and 7 rebounds in his three games with minutes in the 29-34 range. Tobias Harris is out, and Sacramento is missing Keegan Murray and two backup centers, but the 17.5-point spread brings real blowout risk.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He has a double-double in all three games, including 22 points and 14 rebounds in 33 minutes Sunday. Detroit is without Jalen Duren, who will be re-evaluated in two weeks, so Paul Reed is the likely matchup.
notes.Ziaire Williams: He has started all three games for the Lakers and played 30 minutes Sunday. He is a cheap starter in the highest-total game on the slate.
notes.Keldon Johnson: He played 26 minutes off the bench Saturday, his most of the season. Tobias Harris is out with a calf strain, which leaves more forward minutes for him.
notes.Jake LaRavia: He has played 18 and 15 minutes off the bench in his two games and was scoreless Sunday. His appeal is the cheap price in the highest-total game on the slate, not a bigger role.
notes.Luke Kornet: He is San Antonio's backup center at 13 to 16 minutes a night. Sacramento's frontcourt is thin with Keegan Murray, Maxime Raynaud and Dylan Cardwell all out.
notes.Kevin Huerter: His minutes have gone 18, 20 and 26, and Jalen Duren is now out with a hamstring strain. Isaiah Joe is questionable with a hip contusion, which could add more wing minutes.
notes.Collin Sexton: He has played 16 and 20 minutes off the Lakers' bench and scored 13 points Sunday. He is a cheap bench guard in the highest-total game on the slate.
notes.Danny Wolf: He played 15 minutes off the bench in his first game Sunday and scored 10.5 DraftKings points. Brooklyn has Ben Saraf, Drake Powell and Tyler Bilodeau in the G League tonight, and the 11.5-point spread brings blowout risk.
notes.Isaiah Joe: He is questionable with a right hip contusion after a hard fall Sunday, and he played only about four minutes in that game.
notes.Jalen Brunson: He scored 28 points in 32 minutes Sunday. Jose Alvarado is out with a left ankle sprain, so New York's backup guard minutes go to Miles McBride and Tyler Kolek.
notes.Derrick White: He is probable with right hip synovitis.
